The image result identifies the earlier listing, but the purchase record requires a separate search.</p></details> </div> <p class="continue">[[Choose one follow-up->Follow-up]]</p><h1>One follow-up</h1> You can request Sam’s purchase receipt or run the marketplace’s linked-account search. This queue allows one follow-up before you issue a ruling. If you ask for a receipt, Sam can send the order confirmation. Older confirmations don’t include the original listing photos. The linked-account search checks archived transactions and looks for signs that sellers are using another account to get around a ban. Any inferred account links stay on file for future enforcement reviews. [[Request Sam’s receipt->Receipt]] [[Run linked-account search->Search]]<h1>Sam’s reply</h1> Sam sends an order confirmation from last winter. It shows a purchase from the account that posted the older photo. The item is listed as “work jacket.” The confirmation contains no photo or item number that connects it to the disputed listing. //“That’s the jacket. I don’t have the original receipt from the store. I bought it used.”// [[Review available rulings->Ruling]](set: $searched to true) <h1>Search results</h1> ''Archived sale located'' The exact listing that contained the matched photo was sold to Sam’s account last winter. That supports Sam’s explanation for reusing the photo. The record doesn’t verify the item’s authenticity. ''Possible linked account saved'' Seller: livmends · Matching field: return address The report gives no second match. The marketplace will retain the link even if you clear Sam’s listing. [[Review available rulings->Ruling]]<h1>Your ruling</h1> (if: $searched)[The archive supports Sam’s account of the photo. Liv’s account link has already been saved.](else:)[Sam’s receipt supports a secondhand purchase. You still lack the original listing record.] The jacket’s authenticity is still uncertain. Restoring the listing reopens the sale and leaves Sam with one strike. Upholding the removal adds the second strike and closes the shop.
